titulo: Ukrainian drone attacks on Black Sea resort and Crimea kill 11, Russia claims
cuerpo: Seven people, including three children, dead after ‘drone debris’ strike beach in seaside town, says Russian taskforce Ukrainian drone attacks on a Black Sea resort and the annexed Crimea peninsula killed 11 people, Russian officials said, after blaming Ukraine for another explosion that killed five people in a Moscow restaurant. Seven people, including three children, were killed when “drone debris” struck a beach in the seaside town of Arkhipo-Osipovka, the crisis taskforce for Russia’s southern Krasnodar region said on social media.
